This '''Rebel pilot''' was stationed at [[Haven Base]] on the planet [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]]. Following [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] ordeal with the [[Darker]], the pilot found the trio and told them [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was looking for them and that their "vacation" was over. Though the pilot was unaware of the droid's recent adventure, C-3PO was offended by the remark.
